description: Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.

c.request: Matching each constructor standings entry to its race (`races.raceId` = `constructorStandings.raceId`), keep only entries whose season-to-date championship points (`constructorStandings.points`) clear the 6.0-point threshold. Group the kept entries by race name (`races.name`, so same-named races from different years are combined), and for each race name return the name and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values and leaving the average missing if there are none, without rounding. Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.
c.sql: SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId WHERE cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY r.name;

b.request: Among constructor standings entries whose season-to-date points are at least 6.0 (the 6.0 boundary included), joined to races on raceId, group by races.name and return each name with the average constructorStandings.wins, ignoring NULL wins and returning NULL when no non-null wins remain, unrounded.
b.sql: SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId WHERE cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY r.name;
b.raw: Among constructor standings entries whose season-to-date points are at least 6.0 (the 6.0 boundary included), joined to races on raceId, group by races.name and return each name with the average constructorStandings.wins, ignoring NULL wins and returning NULL when no non-null wins remain, unrounded.

d.request: Keep constructorStandings entries where constructorStandings.points equals 6.0 (season-to-date points at or above the threshold, specifically exactly 6.0), join to races on raceId, group by races.name, and return races.name with the AVG of constructorStandings.wins over non-NULL values per name (NULL if none), unrounded.
d.sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId WHERE cs.points = 6.0 GROUP BY r.name;

a.request: Matching each constructor standings entry to its race (`races.raceId` = `constructorStandings.raceId`), keep only entries whose season-to-date championship points (`constructorStandings.points`) are at least 6.0. Group the kept entries by race name (`races.name`, so same-named races from different years are combined), and for each race name return the name and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values and leaving the average missing if there are none, without rounding.
a.sql: SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId WHERE cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY r.name;
